chronology_lookup.method: Direct visual pairing on the full rendered page at normal reading size; source macro size checked afterward, no isolated magnified crop used.
chronology_lookup.example: 1 Thessalonians 1:1–5b -> composition of the First Epistle to the Thessalonians; from Corinth, to Thessalonica -> disputed A.D. 52; A.D. 53–54. The aligned row yields all three parts directly. Matthew 22:15–21 separately yields Jesus answering tribute in the Jerusalem Temple controversies -> date unresolved; the adjacent composition row has different date alternatives and an explicit Aramaic-original qualification.
chronology_lookup.outcome: PASS: occurrence, writing/event place, recipient place and dates can be paired directly without scanning a separate prose column for a subject.
